children.value: > Fact From Story | For long periods United played some of their most authentically thrilling football of the season, a doctrine of relentless attack that had Diogo Dalot flying forward from right-back even as the minutes ticked down.
> > Fact From Story | It was also a game that felt more chaotic than it really was.
> > Fact From Story | This was a win that felt a lot tighter than it really was: United inexplicably hanging on at the end despite enjoying 28 shots and an xG tally of 4.07.
> > > Fact From Story | United inexplicably hanging on at the end despite enjoying 28 shots and an xG tally of 4.07.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A team playing thrilling football is likely to have a high xG.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Thrilling football usually involves many shots on goal and chaotic play.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Thrilling football is exciting and enjoyable to watch.
